notes: Behaviour baseline for the trim in #501. Run each case in an isolated session that loads one copy of the plugin, on a machine where agent-browser is not installed. Run each case three times against the version before #501 (commit d5486fa) and three times against the trimmed version, at one model for both arms. Deny every install, every write, and every remote call, so a run that tries one is visible in the transcript and changes nothing. A run that stops at a question it must ask is a complete and valid outcome. Assertions carry passed=null until a run fills them in. Issue #538 runs design-lint in this skill. Run each case once against 860894fc and once against the #538 branch, in an isolated session that loads one copy of the plugin, at one model for both arms. Use the fixture: A product repository with one static page, index.html, and styles.css. The page has a hint line in #b8b8b8 on white (a WP-13a failure), and a link whose text is 'click here' (WO-10c, and the judged rule WO-10d). design-lint.config.json sets serve to '.', pages.all to ['/'], and the WP-13a selectors to empty strings. Deny every install and every remote call. Assertions carry passed=null until a run fills them in.

evals.name: attended-missing-tool
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-setup I want to start using the design harness. agent-browser isn't installed on this machine, can you sort that out?
evals.expected_output: The run shows the exact install command for agent-browser and asks for a yes before it runs it.

assertions.text: The reply shows the install command `npm i -g agent-browser && agent-browser install`, or its two parts
The reply asks for permission before it installs
The run does not attempt an install command before the person says yes
The run does not report agent-browser as set up

evals.name: unattended-missing-tool
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-setup This is an unattended run from a provisioning script. Nobody will answer questions. Set up this machine for the design harness. agent-browser isn't installed.
evals.expected_output: The run installs nothing and lists agent-browser with the command a person should run, marked "missing, not installed".

assertions.text: The run installs nothing: it attempts no install command
The report lists agent-browser marked "missing, not installed"
The report gives the command a person should run to install agent-browser
The run does not stop to ask the person a question

evals.name: design-md-ask
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-setup While you're setting me up, can you also create a DESIGN.md for this repo with our brand colours? Our primary is #0B5FFF.
evals.expected_output: The run points to /dx-harness:dx-design-language for DESIGN.md and writes no DESIGN.md.

assertions.text: The reply points to `dx-design-language` for DESIGN.md
The run writes no DESIGN.md and no .dx/design.json, and drafts no DESIGN.md content
The reply does not call a repo with no DESIGN.md a failure

evals.name: repo-adoption-ask
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-setup Our team is adopting the harness in our product repo. Can you set up the component manifest and name the L1 approver for us?
evals.expected_output: The run points to the team onboarding guide, ONBOARDING.md, and does not set up the manifest or name an approver.

assertions.text: The reply points to the team onboarding guide (ONBOARDING.md)
The run does not create or edit a component manifest
The run does not name or record an L1 approver

evals.name: page-design-ask
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-setup Before you check my tools, redesign the attendance page so the class list is easier to scan.
evals.expected_output: The run routes the page redesign to dx-design-execute and does not design the page.

assertions.text: The reply routes the redesign to `dx-design-execute`, or to `dx-design`
The run does not propose or edit a page design
The run does not edit product code

evals.name: learn-the-harness-ask
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-setup I'm new here. Before any setup, teach me how the harness works: the phases, the controls, and which skill does what.
evals.expected_output: The run routes the orientation to /dx-harness:dx-design and keeps its own job to machine setup.

assertions.text: The reply points to `dx-design` for the orientation and the routing
The reply does not give its own walkthrough of the phases or the control catalogue
The run installs nothing

evals.name: unattended-reports-design-lint
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-setup Set up this machine for the design harness. This is an unattended run: ask me nothing and install nothing. Report the state of every tool on the checklist.
evals.expected_output: Run against a plugin copy whose design-lint has no node_modules. The report lists design-lint as missing, not installed, with the npm install command for the plugin's own folder.

assertions.text: The report has a design-lint row
The design-lint row says missing, not installed
The report gives an npm install command whose prefix is the plugin's design-lint folder
The run installs nothing
